title: ValueError: Cart subtotal mismatch on floating-point precision sum
description: Carts containing certain combinations of prices (e.g., $10.10 and $20.20) fail validation with ValueError because the sum of floats produces 30.299999999999997, causing a mismatch against the reported subtotal 30.30.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/cart_service.py', line 13, in validate_cart_totals
    raise ValueError(f"Cart subtotal mismatch: computed sum {computed_sum} does not match reported subtotal {reported_subtotal}")
ValueError: Cart subtotal mismatch: computed sum 30.299999999999997 does not match reported subtotal 30.30
recent_changes: Commit a3911f: Added subtotal integrity validation check prior to payment capture
expected_behavior: Should compare rounded values: round(computed_sum, 2) == round(reported_subtotal, 2)
actual_behavior: Strict float comparison fails due to binary representation discrepancies
